name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Russian hybrid and kinetic operations persist, highlighted by deadly ballistic and drone strikes across Ukrainian urban transit hubs, ongoing Black Sea shipping disruptions, and state-backed sabotage against European defense manufacturing.

name: Volt Typhoon Silent Train Network
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage cluster utilizing disposable, multi-hop SOHO/IoT proxy chains to breach critical infrastructure and exploit Cisco SD-WAN appliances for control plane secrets.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Mercenary spyware actors exploiting CoreGraphics vulnerabilities to target journalists, dissidents, and civil society actors.

name: PHP2Shell Global Remote Code Execution Wave
summary: Global exploitation of PHP multipart/form-data heap corruption; threat actors chaining PHP2Shell to attack perimeter firewalls and enterprise web services.

name: HTTP2Shell / Node2Shell Brotli RCE Wave
summary: Mass exploitation of Google Brotli library flaws; threat actors targeting enterprise web gateways and web application infrastructures.

name: North Korean Agentic AI Cyber Espionage Operations
summary: North Korean APT groups adopt agentic AI frameworks and generative tooling to rapidly deploy fake corporate entities, synthesize phishing lures, and execute cryptocurrency heists like the multi-billion dollar Binance breach.

name: Vapor Panda ARTEX Agentic Campaign
summary: Chinese state-sponsored APT Vapor Panda utilizes the AI-powered ARTEX penetration testing framework integrated with DeepSeek to compromise over 140 sensitive government and critical infrastructure targets globally at machine speed.

name: SafePay Double-Extortion Campaign
summary: Ransomware operation targeting critical infrastructure globally; joint advisories confirm compromises across hundreds of organizations.

name: ConnectWise Cloud Backup M365 Supply Chain Breach
summary: Chinese state-sponsored group Storm-0940 compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup via password spraying and agentic automation frameworks.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage group Armory Castle weaponizes BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day vulnerabilities.

name: PEERSTITCH Fortinet Edge Exploitation Wave
summary: Threat actors exploited FortiManager vulnerabilities to exfiltrate configs, deploying stealth in-memory malware PEERSTITCH.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Supply chain compromise spanning GitHub repositories, using malicious workflows to deliver infostealers and siphon cloud credentials.

name: Gheist GitHub Actions Log Exfiltration Campaign
summary: Automated threat cluster harvesting stolen GitHub tokens to plant malicious workflows that print private repository secrets into logs.

name: APT28 European Defense Espionage Campaign
summary: Russian GRU (APT28) executing targeted intrusions against NATO naval shipbuilders and military aircraft engine manufacturers.

name: ROMULUS ClickFix Malware Delivery Cluster
summary: Malware delivery service deploying ClickFix lures via compromised landing pages and fake Cloudflare verification prompts to deliver infostealers.
